mentions.name: Aficionado
mentions.description: This app lets users discover, scrapbook, and remember media — movies, video games, TV shows, music, and books — that resonated with them or that they would like to try.
mentions.source_excerpt: Aficionado (https://aficiona.do) - a place to discover, scrapbook and remember media (movies, video games, tv shows, music and books) that resonated with you or that you'd like to try.
mentions.author: eviluncle

mentions.name: Aficionado
mentions.description: This app is a scrapbook and tracker for media aficionados to remember, share, and discover films, games, music, books, and TV shows they have enjoyed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Aficionado (https://aficiona.do) - a scrapbook/tracker for media aficionados to remember, share and discover films, games, music, books and tv shows they enjoy(ed).
